studies.question: Where does the TTFT delta live: host path or GPU prefill execution?
studies.conditioning: one full 31-step decode conditioning sequence using selected chain, then identical prefill measurement
studies.no_claim: No removal intervention is tested here.

studies.question: Can prepared decode resources alone alter identical-prefill TTFT?
studies.conditioning: no decode execution before measured prefill

studies.question: Does the gap survive neutral conditioning and counterbalanced fresh-process order?
studies.conditioning: identical prefill-only warmup; no decode warmup before TTFT measurement
studies.role: Distinguish stable binary/resource effect from process/order/DVFS bias.

identifiability_logic: H1 supported only if D0 shared-footprint FAST_CONDITIONED > SAFE_CONDITIONED with predeclared effect precision and D1 does not fully account for the delta.
H2 supported only if D1 FAST_ONLY_PREPARED differs from SAFE_ONLY_PREPARED under no-decode conditioning.
H3 supported if host-side delta accounts for the effect while GPU timestamp delta is absent/small.
H4 supported if GPU timestamp prefill delta reproduces under D0 shared-footprint conditioning.
H5 supported if D0 and D1 fail to reproduce a mechanism-specific effect while neutral/order controls explain the original-direction gap.
If multiple mechanisms remain observationally equivalent, terminate identification as NOT_IDENTIFIED rather than select one.
